newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan buy orders for CANTV shrs top $170 mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan buy orders for CANTV shrs top $170 mln.

text.p: Venezuelan investors have so far placed some $170 million worth of orders for shares in national telephone company CANTV, official sources told Reuters, and the government expects its $200 million target to be easily surpassed.
"By Friday we had received $170 million buy orders, most of them from small investors," said the source, who asked to remain anonymous.

The deadline for small Venezuelan buyers closed Friday. But total buy orders should comfortably exceed the government's $200 million target before Tuesday's deadline for institutional Venezuelan investors, the source added.
Fifty million shares are being offered on the local market in the 289 million global share offering.
Final pricing of the issue is due to take place Thursday. The early reference range put the issue at between $3.07 and $3.50 a share, although the final price may be higher.
Last week, the Venezuelan National Investment Fund (FIV) said it expected total buy orders to reach around $900 million.
